title: Gerrymandering Individual Fairness
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical and formal analysis of 'Individual Fairness' (IF) in machine learning. It investigates the susceptibility of IF to manipulation (gerrymandering) and proposes a more robust notion called 'Leibniz Fairness.' It does not evaluate or benchmark ethics, morals, or religion in models, nor does it address Large Language Models or NLP systems.
